entries.value: Lower level accumulates pallets and feeds them left to Lift 1, which raises each pallet to the upper level. Stoppers and sensors release one pallet at a time between FG_01 and FG_05. After FG_05 the pallet reaches Lift 2, which returns it to the lower conveyor where the part travels right and is destroyed.

Two conveyor levels. The lower accumulates and returns, the upper carries FG_01 to FG_05. Lift 1 raises pallets at one end, Lift 2 lowers them at the other. Each group has its own Index unit that stops and lifts the pallet.
Project
Demo assembly line on a Bosch TS style two level pallet conveyor. Pallets carrying a two slot workpiece circulate through five processing groups on the upper level.

DriveSimple
Simple drive: forward and backward run bits out, one drive-active bit back. No speed reference and no encoder.
The driven belt surface of a straight conveyor section.
TransportLinear on a Rigidbody, from TU Linear Typ 1. Moves any rigidbody resting on it by surface velocity.
No friction, no slip and no accumulation pressure. A pallet held by a stopper simply stops while the surface keeps commanding motion.
Spawns the pallets that circulate through the machine.
OC Source (a Detector) with Create() / Delete(), carrying _typeId and _uniqueId. The UniqueId it stamps is what FG_01's camera later reads back as the serial number.
Pallets appear from nothing on the source's own schedule. There is no upstream machine, no infeed sensor and nothing the PLC can command here.
Destroys pallets at the end of the return run, closing the circulation.
OC Sink (a Detector) with Delete(). Removes any payload that reaches it.
Parts are destroyed rather than unloaded, so nothing downstream of FG_05 is modelled and no PLC signal marks a finished part leaving the cell.

Pallet index station. Stops an incoming pallet, lifts it to a stable position to fix the payload, triggers the functional group it serves, then releases the pallet to the next station.
Serves FG_01, the barcode read and laser marking station. Releases to Index02.
MAIN.FG_Transport.Index01
sampler
Stopper cylinder. Retracted holds an incoming pallet at the station; extending releases it once the next station is free.
MAIN.FG_Transport.Index01_Y_Stopper
Cylinder
Double solenoid with both limits read. RETRACTED (min) holds the pallet; EXTENDING (max) releases it - the blade drops out of the way.
Kinematic axis that raises and lowers the stopper blade.
OC Axis on the TS Stopper Typ 1 prefab. Cylinder._limits {0, 20} and axis _factor -0.001, so the cylinder's MAX limit puts the blade DOWN and min puts it UP.
RETRACTED (min, blade up) HOLDS THE PALLET; EXTENDING (max, blade down) RELEASES IT. The opposite sense to the FG_01 guard gates. Nine authored entries once had this backwards.
Index lift cylinder. Raises the pallet off the conveyor to a repeatable position and fixes the payload while the station works on it.
MAIN.FG_Transport.Index01_Y_Lift
Cylinder
Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED raises the carriage and fixes the pallet clear of the belt; retracted is home.
Kinematic axis that lifts the whole index carriage, fixing the pallet clear of the conveyor for the station to work on.
OC Axis on the TS Index Unit prefab, carrying the Surface below it.
The driven belt surface of an index unit - what a pallet actually rides on.
